rulings.decision: Bound recent claims to 10000 IDs per account/socket lifetime; reconcile canonical backend unread/list state after overflow.
rulings.reason: The old global 200-ID cache could recount duplicate IDs after early burst flush and across account changes.
rulings.cost: Very large sessions require additional backend unread reconciliation; evicted IDs cannot be deduplicated locally forever.

rulings.decision: Track at most3 owned individual toast IDs and dismiss retired IDs explicitly.
rulings.reason: Sonner hover can outlive nominal toast duration; account cleanup must not leave old account content onscreen.
rulings.cost: A hover-paused older toast closes when newer admitted individuals replace it.
